subject: Quick note on Hughes & Company's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Hughes & Company stood out.

Tring solicitors on Frogmore Street - and hughesand.co.uk still ships as XHTML 1.0 Transitional with no mobile viewport, and the contact page still publishes fax: 01442 890 772 beside nicola@hughesand.co.uk. Family-run High Street practice; a front end frozen on an early-2000s XHTML stack with a live fax route.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
